description: Mouvements de terrain is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. This dataset brings together all the disasters and disorders to the buildings and infrastructure identified to date, caused by movements of geological terrain. These movements are of 4 types: block falls, muddy slides and castings, slumping of cavities (natural or anthropogenic), differential movements (removal/swelling phenomena). This list was based on bibliographical studies and field observations. Coverage: Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. The portal shows the English title as "Field movements" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Conseil Départemental de l'Hérault. Its keywords include environnement, chutes, glissement, mouvement, territoires-agriculture-et-innovations, affaissement. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, ZIP, JSON. The listing shows 2015-02-24 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
